title: Intel and Broadcom CEOs Warn Capital Scarcity Is the Next AI Bottleneck
summary:
Hock Tan of Broadcom and Lip-Bu Tan of Intel said that access to funding will constrain artificial intelligence growth more than chip or power shortages. Speaking at an event in Singapore on Monday, Broadcom's CEO warned that a capital crunch could become the primary bottleneck for the industry's expansion. Tan also criticized the current investment climate, stating that some investors are betting like they are in a casino and frequently lack an understanding of the technology they are funding.

Intel's CEO stated on the same panel that AI hardware will remain in short supply for the next 2 to 3 years. To illustrate the volatility of current enterprise spending, Hock Tan compared companies burning through AI tokens to children who spend $10 in arcade tokens within 10 minutes.
